items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: I met him in the Navy, in California. I met Jack Teagarden in California.

ctx.x: I was, no, I found them with that man. Same place as she got their uniform. What, uh, you play the sort of, the same way as you're playing now, in those days or something?

Did you play a change or anything? I played the same way. Uh, me and Jack Teagarden, the white fella played at the Palace Theatre. We was the first one started playing, uh, solos on trombone. Yeah? Before Tommy Dawson. Really? Sure. Wasn't it, George? Yeah. The first one started playing solos on trombone. Jack Teagarden. Did I have Jack Teagarden? Sure. Yeah. We went to Vic Gasper together. To where? Vic Gasper. At, uh, the, uh, Trombone. Was Jack Teagarden from here? Jack Teagarden from Texas, but he used to…
Yeah? Yeah? I didn't know. Huh? That's something I didn't know. He's from Texas, but he used to live here.
